Includes retained record handles in adapter inventories.
Rejects export with unsupported RenderSettings carriers before publishing output.
generatedControls: An in-memory ASCII OBJECTS graph with ACAD_RENDER_PLOT_SETTINGS dictionary and one RAPIDRTRENDERSETTINGS record.
Typed kind, handle, owner, name, positional values, raw name, and raw identity assertions.
ASCII and Binary sentinel-preservation checks and same-adapter retry after removing the unsupported graph.
